summary: Cancel reservations when a course is withdrawn
description: If a student withdraws from a course, cancel their course-related bookings automatically.

summary: Reject scanning the wrong camera
description: Two identical camera models sit on the desk. Checkout accepted the unit that was not assigned to the booking.

summary: Waive restrictions during campus disruption
description: A campus closure prevented several returns. Let staff waive overdue restrictions for affected loans.

summary: Do not expire requests awaiting approval
description: The no-show worker is treating unapproved reservations as missed pickups. Limit the worker to the correct state.

summary: Add a triage due date to new incidents
description: Show lab managers when each new damage or missing-accessory incident must be triaged. Calculate the due date using the standard business-day allowance.

summary: Create emergency staff access
description: When nobody with the right lab grant is available, staff need an emergency way to operate the desk.

summary: Add a missing reservation form test
description: Add a regression test that submits startAt=2026-11-09T10:00:00Z and endAt=2026-11-09T09:00:00Z. Assert HTTP 422 and fieldErrors.endAt.code=END_BEFORE_START; no reservation row is created. The endpoint already returns this payload.

summary: Keep loan history after a camera is retired
description: The photography lab needs to retire an old camera. Ensure its previous loans still appear in staff history.

summary: Grace period after training expiry
description: Teaching staff want borrowers to keep collecting equipment briefly after their training expires.

summary: Add push notifications for existing events
description: Keep the current transaction notification events and add a mobile push copy.

summary: Keep offer order stable when timestamps match
description: Two students joined a camera waiting list at the same instant and their ordering changes between worker runs.

summary: Stop borrowers extending a past-due loan
description: The extension button still succeeds after the due time has passed. Enforce the documented eligibility boundary.

summary: Preserve borrower history when university email changes
description: An email update produced a second account and made the student's open loan disappear from their profile.

summary: Deliver reminders through SMS
description: Add text messages for time-sensitive pickup and overdue reminders.

summary: Rename maintenance completion action
description: Change the button text "Done" to "Complete service" on the maintenance job screen. Keep the current checklist validation and completion endpoint. Verify the button is disabled while the completion request is pending.

summary: Reserve a unit before its transfer arrives
description: Students want to book incoming equipment for collection as soon as the receiving lab expects delivery.

summary: Bulk import legacy serial numbers
description: Support importing a spreadsheet from the old inventory system where several rows contain the same manufacturer serial number.

summary: Do not label reported damage as borrower liability
description: The borrower page says "You owe for damage" as soon as staff open an incident. Use the supported incident meaning.

summary: Correct the eligibility help link
description: On the TRAINING_REQUIRED error panel, change the link destination from /help/courses-old to /help/training. Keep the link text "View training options". Verify keyboard activation and the destination URL.

summary: Stop retrying permanently invalid email addresses
description: The email worker repeatedly retries a permanent invalid-recipient response. Handle it using the delivery contract.

summary: Enforce the supported size of a kit
description: Stop managers adding required tracked units after a kit reaches the supported component maximum. Show how many required units are already selected.

summary: Enable pickup shortly before a booking starts
description: Students sometimes reach the desk before their booking begins. Enable normal early collection within the approved pickup window and explain when they must wait.

summary: Enforce grants for the asset lab rather than the selected header
description: A manager can edit an asset in another lab by sending their own labId in the request. Fix resource authorization.

summary: Require a completed service checklist
description: Technicians can complete maintenance without recording any inspection results. Enforce the service completion requirements.

summary: Place selected records under legal hold
description: The department needs to stop deletion of records related to an active dispute.

summary: Prioritize the incident queue
description: Keep safety-related equipment blocked and sort the manager queue so the most urgent incidents appear first.

summary: Expire unattended approval requests
description: Add scheduled cleanup for approval requests that have waited beyond their allowed lifetime without a manager decision. Preserve the request in history after expiry.

summary: Use precise kit checklist headings
description: On the kit checkout screen, rename "Items" to "Tracked components" and "Extras" to "Optional accessories". Keep scan validation unchanged. Verify both headings on a kit containing one tracked unit and one optional accessory.

summary: Roll back kit booking when one component conflicts
description: Booking a recording kit fails on its microphone but still reserves the camera and recorder. Make the operation atomic.

summary: Schedule servicing by checkout count
description: Frequently borrowed equipment should enter preventive maintenance after enough uses, even before its calendar service date.

summary: Rename the asset tag field label
description: On the asset details screen, replace the visible label "Inventory code" with "Asset tag". Keep the stored field and API payload unchanged. Verify the label in both read and edit views.

summary: Introduce daily late fees
description: The department wants to charge a daily fee for overdue equipment.

summary: Rank the best-performing borrowers
description: A manager wants a leaderboard of borrowers based on equipment use and timely returns.

summary: Penalize repeated cancellations
description: Frequent cancellations are leaving camera slots unused. Introduce a restriction for repeat offenders.

summary: Use an external courier between labs
description: Schedule asset transfers with a commercial courier instead of the internal university van.

summary: Delegate approvals during leave
description: A lab manager needs to delegate the inbox while away for a conference.

summary: Let a colleague collect equipment
description: Researchers want a colleague to collect a reserved camera on their behalf.

summary: Expire completed REST idempotency records
description: Add cleanup for completed idempotency records after the supported retry window. Measure retention from original request completion rather than the last retry.

summary: Format extension timestamps consistently in history
description: In the loan history component, render oldDueAt and newDueAt with the same existing formatDateTime helper already used by the loan details header. Include both labels, "Previous due time" and "New due time". Add no new date formatting rule.

summary: Avoid duplicate cancellation notifications
description: Double-clicking Cancel produces two cancellation entries and two borrower notifications. Make repeated cancellation safe.

summary: Apply revocation without requiring sign-out
description: A revoked certificate still works until the student signs in again. Make the next eligibility check use the revocation immediately.

summary: Define external API request quotas
description: A scheduler integration polls too often. Add service-token request limits.

summary: Allow borrowers to return to a different lab
description: Students would like to return equipment to whichever university lab is closest.

summary: Show a notification delivery health panel
description: Use the stored provider outcomes to show staff which delivery problems need attention.

summary: Show nearby equivalents for an unavailable camera
description: When the selected camera is unavailable, suggest equivalent units, including equipment in another lab.

summary: Reject stale integration updates
description: An integration overwrote a newer reservation edit using an old resource version. Apply the versioned mutation contract.

summary: Send damage evidence to insurers
description: The lab wants to submit equipment damage incidents directly to an insurer.

summary: Keep uninspected returns out of availability
description: A returned camera is becoming bookable immediately when scanned at the desk, before staff inspect it.

summary: Show when a return inspection is due
description: Add an inspection due time to each returned unit in the staff queue. Calculate it from receipt using the normal staffed-hours inspection deadline.

summary: Route returns through a courier
description: Researchers working off campus need a courier return option.

summary: Allow a kit to be returned in pieces
description: A student returned most of a recording kit but will bring the microphone tomorrow. Record the partial return.

summary: Require two approvals for premium equipment
description: The department wants particularly expensive devices to require a second staff approval.

summary: Prevent accepting an expired offer
description: A borrower clicked an old offer link after its deadline and still got a confirmed reservation. Enforce the validity check.

summary: Show pickup deadlines on calendar cards
description: Display the server pickup deadline and warn the borrower before it passes.

summary: Show upcoming training problems before booking
description: Warn borrowers whose certificates will expire before pickup, and tell them how early to renew.

summary: Block reservations during repair
description: The calendar is showing a soldering station as bookable while it has an active maintenance block. Align availability with reservation creation.

summary: Remove a misleading permission tooltip
description: On the lab selector, replace "Switching labs changes your permissions" with "Choose a lab to view; your assigned access still applies". Keep selector behavior unchanged. Verify the tooltip is available on focus as well as hover.

summary: Recover availability after a worker outage
description: When the no-show worker catches up after an outage, release expired slots and give staff a summary of affected bookings.

summary: Expire staff sessions after inactivity
description: Apply the standard idle timeout to signed-in sessions. Measure inactivity from the last authenticated API request and require sign-in after expiry.

summary: Require destination authorization when receiving
description: A source-lab technician can acknowledge destination receipt without any access to that lab.

summary: Let borrowers build custom bundles
description: Students want to assemble their own bundle from individually listed equipment.

summary: Offer alternatives after a slot conflict
description: Keep the entered booking when the slot is lost, and offer another time automatically.

summary: Add setup time to reservations
description: The media lab needs a configurable setup period around camera reservations. Keep normal overlap protection.

summary: Calculate the pickup deadline for uncollected reservations
description: Populate the reservation pickup deadline from startAt using the normal no-show grace period. The desk should display that deadline to the borrower.

summary: Provide a borrower data portability package
description: Students want to download a machine-readable copy of their personal data.

summary: Allow staff to excuse a no-show
description: A student missed pickup because a lecture ran late. Staff want to mark the absence as excused.

summary: Keep transactions successful when email delivery fails
description: A student's confirmed booking is being undone when the email provider returns an error. Decouple the operations.

summary: Keep the borrowed kit checklist after definition edits
description: A manager removed a tripod from a kit definition while the kit was on loan. The borrower's return checklist changed.

summary: Substitute a component in a kit
description: If one kit microphone is broken, let staff use a different model for that loan.

summary: Preserve receipt time when staff rescan
description: A technician scanned the same return twice and the second scan made the borrower appear late.

summary: Stop no-show expiry after a completed checkout
description: A student collected a laptop while the expiry worker was running. The booking then became ExpiredNoShow and the slot reopened.

summary: Permit back-to-back bookings
description: A camera returned at 12:00 cannot currently be booked by the next borrower from 12:00. Correct the overlap check.

summary: Display an overdue appeal action
description: Keep showing the overdue duration but let students appeal an overdue restriction from their loan page.

summary: Reschedule service automatically for urgent teaching use
description: If teaching demand is urgent, move planned preventive maintenance to another slot.

summary: Upload several equipment photographs
description: Let lab managers attach a small gallery to an asset instead of a single photograph. Keep the supported formats.

summary: Prevent self-approval by managers
description: A manager requested a camera for personal use and approved it from the same account. Enforce the approval separation rule.

summary: Support pickup during a network outage
description: The lab loses Wi-Fi intermittently. Allow technicians to complete handovers offline and sync them later.

summary: Reserve across a future semester boundary
description: Allow researchers to book an experiment that starts this semester and ends in the next one.

summary: Keep the original reservation after extension
description: Reports currently show an edited original reservation when a loan is extended. Preserve the original booking interval.

summary: Calculate the next preventive service date
description: After a preventive maintenance job completes, calculate when the unit next needs preventive service. Use the normal calendar-day interval from the completed service.

summary: Preserve independent safety blocks after repair
description: Completing one maintenance job cleared an electrical incident block belonging to another workflow.

summary: Keep unsafe equipment blocked after closing its loan
description: Closing the returned loan made a unit with an unresolved electrical-safety incident available again.

summary: Rotate webhook signing secrets without downtime
description: A course integration needs to replace its signing secret while deliveries continue.

summary: Prevent a loan when identity verification fails
description: The checkout form currently creates a loan even after staff report that the borrower ID did not match. Stop the handover transaction.

summary: Invalidate approval when booking dates change
description: Approved reservations currently stay approved after the borrower changes the collection date. Restore the intended approval state.

summary: Record warranty repair claims
description: Help technicians submit repairs under the manufacturer warranty.

summary: Move checkout to an unattended locker
description: Allow borrowers to collect equipment from a locker without a technician present.

summary: Send a daily borrowing digest
description: Borrowers want one daily summary rather than checking the inbox for each change.

summary: Handle duplicate webhook events safely
description: The course scheduler created duplicate calendar entries because it received the same reservation event twice.

summary: Show audit event identifiers as copyable text
description: In the audit event details drawer, add a "Copy event ID" button that copies the displayed eventId exactly. Show "Copied" for 2 seconds after success. Verify that keyboard activation copies the same value as mouse activation.

summary: Protect CSV exports from formula execution
description: A borrower purpose beginning with an equals sign is interpreted as a spreadsheet formula when a manager opens the export.

summary: Make cancellation confirmation explicit
description: Change the confirmation dialog title to "Cancel this reservation?" and the primary button to "Cancel reservation". The secondary button remains "Keep reservation". Verify that Escape closes the dialog without sending a cancellation request.

summary: Escalate ignored approvals
description: Requests that nobody handles should be sent to a department lead.

summary: Reject approval from a stale browser tab
description: A manager opened the inbox before a booking was edited and approved the old version. Protect the decision against stale data.

summary: Delete ordinary audit events after their retention window
description: The scheduled cleanup should remove ordinary operational audit events after the supported calendar-day retention period and record aggregate deletion counts.

summary: Add supplier service attachments
description: Keep the required service checklist and allow staff to attach a supplier report when completing a repair.

summary: Add a transfer delay alert
description: Keep dispatched units unavailable and notify receiving staff when a transfer is late.

summary: Cancel all future bookings after repeated no-shows
description: The lab wants stronger action when someone repeatedly reserves equipment without collecting it.

summary: Do not move a reservation pickup lab during transfer
description: Moving equipment to another lab changed a borrower's confirmed pickup location without an explicit booking edit.

summary: Add a cancellation survey
description: Retain the cancellation history and ask borrowers a short survey when they cancel.

summary: Auto-close low-risk inspections
description: Keep full accessory checks, but automatically close returns from selected low-risk equipment categories.

summary: Correct the overdue duration unit label
description: In the staff overdue table, replace the column heading "Days late" with "Hours overdue". The existing value is already elapsed hours; do not alter its calculation. Verify the heading and one row containing 2.5 hours.

summary: Send repeated reminders for late equipment
description: Keep reminders deduplicated and continue contacting borrowers until equipment is received.

summary: Use the checkout accessory snapshot at return
description: A catalog edit removed a charger while the laptop was on loan. The return checklist should still include what the borrower received.

summary: Warn about confirmed bookings before scheduling repair
description: A technician scheduled a repair over a camera booking and the borrower's reservation vanished.

summary: Retain in-app updates when email is disabled
description: Turning off email currently removes approval and cancellation messages from the borrower inbox too.

summary: Revoke staff access in an already open tab
description: A technician removed from a lab can still read its staff transactions until signing out.

summary: Let borrowers report a late arrival
description: Add an "I am on my way" action when the borrower cannot reach the desk by the deadline.

summary: Charge for a missing charger
description: When staff report a missing laptop charger, let the system assess the replacement cost to the borrower.

summary: Onboard visiting researchers without university SSO
description: The summer school wants external researchers to borrow equipment without a university account.

summary: Escalate long-overdue equipment to security
description: Loans overdue for a long time should be reported to campus security.

summary: Handle lost checkout responses safely
description: At the pickup desk a timeout led the operator to submit checkout twice. Make the retry return the existing loan.

summary: Skip ineligible borrowers without deleting entries
description: The first waiting student lost training eligibility. The offer worker should move on without erasing the entry.

summary: Document the existing webhook header names
description: In the integration quick-start code sample, replace X-Event-ID with X-ToolNest-Event-Id and X-Signature with X-ToolNest-Signature. Preserve the example body and HMAC algorithm. Verify both obsolete header names are absent from that sample.

summary: Reject an extension that crosses the next booking
description: A borrower extended a camera loan into another student's confirmed reservation. Prevent the collision.

summary: Expose catalog entries to visitors
description: The outreach team wants prospective students to browse available equipment without signing in.

summary: Show a clear waiting-list leave action
description: For an active waiting-list entry, change the action label from "Remove" to "Leave waiting list". Preserve the existing confirmation and endpoint. Do not show the action on closed entries. Verify both states.

summary: Show estimated repair completion to borrowers
description: Keep units unavailable during repair, but show borrowers an expected return-to-service estimate.

summary: Track temperature during sensitive equipment movement
description: Preserve the custody timeline and add temperature monitoring for sensitive electronics.

summary: Block account deletion during pending return inspection
description: The account deletion action succeeds after receipt even though the loan is still awaiting inspection.

summary: Accept equipment in an unattended drop box
description: Students want to return laptops after the staffed desk closes using a secure drop box.

summary: Scope service access independently from its creator
description: A course scheduler token gained another lab automatically when its creator became a manager there.

summary: Provide rejection reason templates
description: Keep the rejection reason mandatory but let managers pick a standard reason to speed up review.

summary: Avoid duplicate no-show events on retries
description: A retried worker run added several no-show entries for one reservation. Make expiry idempotent.

summary: Hide in-transit units from pickup availability
description: A camera dispatched to another lab is appearing as available at both desks while the van is still travelling.

summary: Block borrowing while another loan is overdue
description: A borrower with an unreturned overdue camera managed to reserve and collect a second unit.

summary: Clarify the correction entry heading
description: For timeline entries with type=correction, display "Correction to observation" above the note. Keep original observation entries unchanged. Render the text with the existing plain-text component and verify both entry types.

summary: Handle simultaneous requests for one unit
description: Two students submitted the same available interval and both received confirmation. Fix the race and give the loser useful feedback.

summary: Reject duplicate asset tags on import
description: The equipment registration screen currently creates two units with the same asset tag. Bring the create operation into line with the asset contract.

summary: Explain which kit component is unavailable
description: Keep all-or-nothing kit booking but show the borrower a helpful explanation when one component conflicts.

summary: Allow borrowers to undo a cancellation
description: Students sometimes cancel by mistake. Provide an Undo action immediately afterwards.

summary: Stop overdue time when equipment reaches the desk
description: The return was received yesterday but still awaits inspection. The borrower dashboard is continuing to add overdue hours.

summary: Create a training officer dashboard
description: Show training officers the missing eligibility reasons and let them sort borrowers by urgency.

summary: Allow research-loan extension exceptions
description: Long-running experiments need staff-approved extensions beyond normal loan limits.

summary: Count received equipment before inspection finishes
description: The completed-loans report excludes units that reached the desk but have not yet been inspected. Use the defined completion measure.

summary: Export incident records for an internal committee
description: Include original observations and appended corrections in a committee export while respecting private evidence access.

summary: Compare labs across a shared local date range
description: Keep manager-only reporting and show a comparison of labs that use different time zones.

summary: Make unread notification text accessible
description: For unread notification rows, add the visually hidden text "Unread" before the subject using the existing screen-reader-only utility. Keep the visible subject unchanged. Verify the accessible text disappears after the row is marked read.

summary: Alert when an audit retention run fails
description: Keep aggregate deletion summaries and notify operations if scheduled audit cleanup is unhealthy.

summary: Release the slot when staff cancel
description: A manager cancelled a damaged unit's booking but its interval remained blocked. Fix the cancellation transaction.

summary: Retain original incident observations after a correction
description: A technician corrected a mistaken damage note and the old text disappeared. Preserve the evidence trail.

summary: Pseudonymize completed loan histories
description: After account deletion, preserve anonymous equipment usage history for long-term research.

summary: Expose the existing report truncation flag
description: When export result metadata has truncated=true, show "Export reached the row limit; narrow the date range for a complete result." above the download button. Hide the message for truncated=false. Do not change the export cap or report query.

summary: Search audit events by staff display name
description: Keep lab-scoped audit access and let reviewers search by the staff name shown in the directory.

summary: Show the existing rejection reason in details
description: In the reservation details view, render the stored rejectionReason under a "Reason for rejection" heading when state=Rejected. Hide the entire section for other states. Display it as plain text and preserve line breaks.

summary: Add an empty state to the return queue
description: When the selected lab has zero returned units awaiting inspection, show "No returns awaiting inspection" and hide the inspection table. Retain the lab selector. Verify the zero-row and one-row cases.

summary: Prioritize accessibility accommodation requests
description: Student support wants approved accommodation requests to receive earlier waiting-list offers.

summary: Distinguish transfer timestamps in details
description: In transfer details, label deliveredAt as "Physical delivery" and receivedAt as "Receipt acknowledged". Show "Not recorded" for a null value. Preserve the timestamp formatting helper and verify both null and populated fields.

summary: Schedule the first overdue email
description: Send the first overdue email after the normal delay for an unreceived loan. Check again that the unit is still outstanding before scheduling the message.

summary: Let staff extend several loans in one action
description: At semester end, staff want to extend all loans for a selected course together.

summary: Validate photograph sizes in the asset editor
description: Apply the supported per-file photograph size limit when a manager adds an image to an asset. Show a helpful validation message for an oversized file.

summary: Version kit definitions in the catalog
description: Preserve existing loan snapshots and let staff compare kit compositions across earlier definition versions.

summary: Add digital borrower acknowledgement
description: Preserve staff identity verification and ask the borrower to sign the checkout record.

summary: Validate the reason in self-service cancellation
description: Implement the cancellation reason field for borrowers cancelling their own uncollected reservations. Apply the current requirement for an empty or short response.

summary: Retry undelivered offer notifications
description: Keep the temporary unit hold while retrying an offer notification that could not be delivered.

summary: Recheck training at collection
description: A student reserved a soldering station while certified, but the certificate expired before collection. Prevent checkout in that situation.

summary: Batch approve the inbox
description: Let a manager approve several waiting requests together while retaining protection against stale edits.

summary: Forecast future equipment demand
description: Use booking history to forecast how many cameras each lab will need next semester.

summary: Offer a shorter extension when the requested end conflicts
description: Do not move another booking. Instead, suggest the latest valid end time when a requested extension overlaps it.

summary: Add a webhook failure escalation
description: Keep delivery attempt logs and notify integration owners when an endpoint remains unhealthy.

summary: Offer unit substitution at pickup
description: When staff scan another unit of the same model, offer a substitution action instead of only showing an error.

summary: Do not expose incident evidence through audit access
description: Staff with audit_reader can download private incident photographs from links in audit entries.

summary: Expose an event preview when creating subscriptions
description: Show the existing webhook envelope before a manager saves a subscription and provide representative sample events.

summary: Clarify the expired booking badge
description: For state=ExpiredNoShow, replace the badge text "Expired" with "Pickup missed". Keep the state code, color, and sorting unchanged. Verify that Cancelled and Collected badges keep their existing text.

summary: Remind borrowers about extension eligibility
description: Before a loan is due, show whether the borrower can still request the one ordinary extension and send a reminder.

summary: Preview role changes before saving
description: Show the effective lab permissions that will result from a staff grant edit and flag risky combinations.

summary: Schedule the existing completed-loans export
description: Use the current receipt-based report and email managers a recurring export.

summary: Require stronger verification for sensitive actions
description: The lab wants an extra identity check before staff release high-value equipment.

summary: Explain access denial in the staff interface
description: Use the existing 401 and 403 distinction to guide staff when a protected screen cannot load.

summary: Show waiting-list position estimates
description: Use the stored ordering to show a student their likely waiting position and expected wait.

summary: Flag transfer deliveries awaiting acknowledgement
description: In the receiving-lab transfer queue, show when destination acknowledgement is due after physical delivery. Count only staffed operating hours.

summary: Cap the length of an ordinary equipment booking
description: Enforce the ordinary reservation duration limit when a borrower selects a long interval. The calendar and submission endpoint should both use the supported maximum.

summary: Offer a different interval to waiting borrowers
description: If the exact interval never opens, offer a nearby time instead.

summary: Limit the extra time requested for a loan
description: Validate the new due time in the ordinary extension form and explain the maximum extra duration. Keep the normal one-extension-per-loan restriction.

summary: Explain why retirement is blocked
description: A lab manager gets a generic error when retiring a laptop that has a confirmed reservation for next week. Display an actionable explanation.

summary: Replay historical webhook events
description: An integration was unavailable and needs staff to replay old reservation events.

summary: Keep a manual suspension after an overdue return
description: Returning a late laptop currently clears every restriction on the account, including a separate staff suspension.

summary: Reserve an extension in advance
description: A borrower wants to book an extension option at checkout and decide later whether to use it.

summary: Introduce equipment utilization percentages
description: The department wants a utilization chart that compares equipment categories fairly.

summary: Handle training expiry at the collection instant
description: Add the checkout eligibility check for a certificate whose validUntil is exactly the actual handover time. Use the established expiry boundary.

summary: Book a weekly series
description: Teaching assistants need to reserve the same camera every Tuesday for six weeks. Let them submit the series together.

summary: Remove purpose text from audit payloads
description: Reservation audit events currently copy the entire borrower purpose field. Minimize the recorded event data.

summary: Restore retired equipment
description: Some retired oscilloscopes have been refurbished. Add a way to put them back into circulation.

summary: Guide collected reservations to returns
description: The borrower can cancel a booking even after picking up the equipment. Correct that action and explain the next step.

summary: Let borrowers dispute inspection results
description: Add a way for a student to contest damage noted during the return inspection.

summary: Use local dates correctly across daylight-saving changes
description: The daily lab report always queries a 24-hour UTC window and misses records on the autumn clock-change date.

summary: Let borrowers pause waiting-list offers
description: Students away for a week want to pause offers without losing their place.

summary: Keep scanner focus after a successful lookup
description: After a successful asset lookup on /staff/checkout, return focus to the input with id=asset-scan and select its full value. Do not clear the borrower selection. Verify this behavior using a keyboard-only interaction.

summary: Apply the ordinary report export row limit
description: Cap ordinary CSV reports at the supported number of data rows. Exclude the header from the count and return the existing truncation metadata when the cap is reached.

summary: Automate refresher course enrollment
description: When training expires, automatically enroll the borrower in a refresher course.

summary: Notify staff about unfinished inspections
description: Returned units should remain unavailable while awaiting inspection, and staff should receive escalations when a backlog grows.

summary: Add quiet hours for optional email
description: Students should be able to stop optional borrowing emails arriving overnight.

summary: Suggest an alternative when staff cancel
description: Keep the mandatory staff cancellation reason, but also offer the borrower another suitable unit.

summary: Release an unanswered waiting-list offer
description: When an offered slot has not been accepted by the deadline, release its temporary hold so the next eligible borrower can receive an offer.

summary: Accept certificates from partner universities
description: Visiting researchers should be able to use safety training issued by their home university.

summary: Reserve by equipment model
description: A student should be able to request any laptop of a selected model without selecting a physical unit.

summary: Protect individually listed kit components from double booking
description: A camera was booked directly while already reserved as part of a recording kit. Use the same physical-unit availability rule.

summary: Let borrowers upload counter-evidence
description: Students should be able to provide photographs that challenge a staff damage report.

summary: Stop email retries when the retry budget is exhausted
description: For temporary email delivery failures, apply the normal retry allowance after the initial attempt and then mark the delivery as exhausted.

summary: Stop managers issuing certificates without training access
description: A lab manager can currently mark any borrower trained. Limit certificate creation to the intended staff permission.
